svg.title: Full goal tree: person splits into Loonie or one of six tourist types
svg.desc: A person is either a Loonie, based on adapted physical and political traits, or a tourist, based on shared unadapted traits, then further split into six specific tourist types: Earther Sightseer, Belt Miner on Leave, Corporate Auditor, Honeymooners, Rock-hound Collector, and Repatriation Relative.
